description:
Chill golden-hour background with a little friendly crab :)

[h2]Settings[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Waves[/b]: all the movement on the water (0 = glassy).
[*][b]Seabed[/b]: how much of the sandy bottom shows through.
[*][b]Trees[/b]: how much the trees move in the wind (0 = still).
[*][b]Clouds[/b]: how fast the clouds drift (0 = still).
[*][b]Crab[/b]: how often the crab comes out (0 = never).
[/list]
Brightness, contrast and colour are in Wallpaper Engine's own colour options. The frame rate follows its FPS setting.
